summary: Implemented and rebased resource-local read-only runtime behavior for ocicontrolcenter/MetricProperty.
details: Added a MetricProperty runtime wrapper that binds by required selector annotations, scans all ListMetricProperties pages, projects metric dimensions/status, records a stable synthetic identity, and rejects selector drift before OCI calls.

Handled the SDK's list-only surface by treating Kubernetes deletion as read-only binding removal with no OCI delete, and added focused tests for bind/readback, pagination, selector fallback, drift rejection, OCI error request IDs, and delete behavior.
Rebased the implementation onto source head 9225eb67afdf615aac37d138351f2095a0b10b5c.
